# Vampire
[color=#ac1a1a]An undead predator, hiding among the crew, who survives on stolen blood.[/color]
A vampire heals on borrowed blood, fears the solar flares that sweep the station, and cannot truly be killed by ordinary means.
## Spotting a vampire - A vampire is an ordinary crew member with their usual name and job. They are never command, security, a borg or the AI. They only appear on stations with 20 or more players, one for every 20 players, and at most three. - Nothing on their body gives them away, so watch what they do instead. - During a solar flare, a vampire caught in the open bursts into flames for no reason, or dives into a locker or coffin. - A vampire's victims are left drained of blood, with no wound to show for it. While it feeds, the victim is held down and cannot move. - A vampire never eats, drinks or breathes, and sees in the dark.
# Playing a vampire
## Blood Everything runs on [bold]blood[/bold], shown by the drop alert on your screen. You start with 100 of a possible 600. - Being awake drains 0.1 blood a second. Your active powers drain more. - While you have blood, you heal 0.3 brute and 0.3 toxin damage a second. Burns only heal in your coffin or in torpor. - At 0 blood you stop healing and start to shake.
[bold]Feed[/bold] on someone you hold in at least a soft grab, with your mouth uncovered. In combat mode, press pull again on someone you are dragging to tighten it into a grab. Each second you drain 15 blood from them and gain it yourself, or only half as much from animals. The victim is pinned for as long as you keep feeding. Feeding too long bleeds them dry. Press Feed again to stop, and only then does its 30-second cooldown start. Garlic stops you feeding, but a stake does not.
## Your coffin Climb into any closet or crate and close the lid from inside, and it becomes your [bold]coffin[/bold]. You can only own one. If it is destroyed, you can claim another. You can build a proper coffin from 5 wooden planks.
Staying inside your own coffin with the lid shut stops your blood drain and heals brute, toxin [italic]and[/italic] burn damage four times faster, for free. It is also the only place where you can grow in power, and the only real shelter from Sol.
## Sol A solar flare bombards the station 15 minutes after the round's first vampire appears. Each night after that is 100 seconds longer than the last. Only vampires and their vassals are warned, in chat with a sound, 90 seconds, 25 seconds and 5 seconds before it starts. The flare lasts one minute, and every 4 seconds it burns you, ignoring all your resistances: - [bold]Out in the open[/bold]: 2 heat damage, plus 1 per rank. From rank 1 on, it also sets you on fire. - [bold]Inside a locker, crate or anything else[/bold]: only 0.5 heat damage, plus 0.5 per rank. - [bold]In your own closed coffin[/bold]: nothing at all.
Torpor does not heal you while the flare is up, and enough burn damage is final death, so take cover. When a flare ends, every vampire, wherever they are, gains one rank to spend.
## Growing in power You start with one rank to spend. Inside your own closed coffin, with at least 20% of your maximum blood, right-click yourself and pick [bold]Grow in power[/bold]. That costs the blood, and you can choose to learn one new power. Your first rank costs 120 blood, so feed before you try. Every rank also gives: - +100 maximum blood. - +2 blood per second of feeding. - Slightly faster healing. - Room for one more vassal.
The powers you can learn: - [bold]Fortitude[/bold] (30 blood, then 0.25 a second): take 30% less brute damage while it is on. - [bold]Cloak of Darkness[/bold] (5 blood, then 0.04 a second): turn half-invisible. Any damage tears the cloak away. - [bold]Mesmerize[/bold] (30 blood, 5-minute cooldown): stare at someone right next to you for 6 seconds. If you stay still, they stay within reach, and you are not hurt, they are paralyzed for 15 seconds.
Once you know all three, ranking up only improves your stats.
## Masquerade [bold]Masquerade[/bold] costs 10 blood, then another 0.1 a second, and stops all of your healing while it is on, even in torpor. Its 50-second cooldown starts when you switch it off. Nothing on the station can actually detect a vampire, so it is purely a roleplay tool for acting alive.
## Torpor Dying does not end a vampire. You fall into [bold]torpor[/bold] instead. Your body heals brute, toxin, burn and suffocation damage at twice your normal rate, without spending blood, and you get back up on your own once you have healed enough. Torpor stops healing while Sol is up, while you are staked, with garlic in you, or while Masquerade is on. Entering torpor frees all of your vassals.
## Vassals [bold]Embrace[/bold] someone right next to you who is in critical condition or dead. It takes 10 seconds of standing still and has a 20-second cooldown. You can keep one vassal per rank, so a fresh vampire can keep none. Mindshielded crew, other vampires and existing vassals cannot be embraced.
A vassal must keep you alive and gets two powers: - [bold]Sanguine Recuperation[/bold] (toggle): heals 1 brute and 1 toxin damage a second, using 2 of their own blood a second. It stops when their blood drops below 30%. - [bold]Sense Master[/bold]: tells them how many tiles away you are.
Vassals are warned 25 seconds before each solar flare. All of them go free the moment you die, even if it is only torpor.
## Objectives - [bold]Claim a Lair[/bold]: own a coffin. - [bold]Raise a Protégé[/bold]: have at least one vassal. - [bold]Blood Harvest[/bold]: feed on at least 3 different victims. - [bold]Survive[/bold] to the end of the round.
## The candelabrum You can build a candelabrum from 3 steel, 1 metal rod and 1 candle. Use it to light or snuff it. While it is lit, it glows a cold blue and unsettles everyone within 5 tiles who is not a vampire or vassal, souring their mood.
# Hunting a vampire
## Final death A vampire only stays dead after one of these: - A [bold]stake[/bold] through the heart while they are in critical condition, in torpor, asleep, or drained of all blood. - [bold]300 burn damage[/bold] from fire, shocks, acid or the solar flare. - Losing their [bold]brain or heart[/bold].
After a final death, nothing can revive them. Vampires can never be cloned, even before that.
## Stakes
Craft a wooden stake from 2 wooden planks, harden it with a welder, then cap it with a silver sheet. A stake only goes in while the vampire is lying down. Click them with it and stand still while you drive it in: 12 seconds for wood, 8 for hardened, or 6 for silver.
If the vampire is still conscious and has blood, you [bold]miss the heart[/bold]. Their powers and healing are then locked for 60 seconds with wood, 90 with hardened, or 120 with silver. They can still feed, though. Knock them out first, or wait until they are in torpor, then stake them again.
## Garlic
Garlic stops a vampire from healing, using any power, or feeding. Get them to eat garlic or any food cooked with it, and each unit of allicin lasts 20 seconds. Or hang a [bold]garlic necklace[/bold] around their neck, made from 3 garlic and 10 cable. It works for as long as they wear it, so cuff them so they cannot take it off.
## Using Sol The crew is never told when a flare comes, but a vampire is. If you have one cuffed, keep them out in the open: every flare burns and ignites them, and torpor cannot heal them until it ends.
